43/2024, under Sections 363/376 of the IPC and Section 6 of the Prevention of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, (for short, POCSO Act), registered at P.S. Mayur Vihar, East Delhi.

It is further submitted that, as per the said reply, survivor was medically examined on 06.03.2024, wherein again she did not make any allegations of sexual assault against the applicant.
Thereafter, on 11.03.2024, in the statement of survivor, under Section 164 of the CrPC, recorded before learned Metropolitan Magistrate also she did not make any allegations of sexual assault.

It is pointed out that on 12.03.2024, when the survivor was produced before the CWC Cell, she for the first time Guddu Kumar vs State (N.C.T. Of Delhi) on 14 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69674555/

sentences.text: It is further submitted that even in the FIR recorded at the instance of the mother of the survivor, the age of her daughter/survivor has been stated to be more than 16 years.
It is the case of the applicant that the survivor had married the applicant.
4. Issue notice.
5. Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks time to file a status report.
Let the same be done before the next date of hearing, with an advance copy to learned counsel for the applicant.

6. List before the Roster Bench on 11.07.2024.
7.
In the meantime, on the applicant joining the investigation as and when directed by the Investigating Officer, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant till the next date of hearing.
8. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court, forthwith.
